bill.title: Homeowner's insurance policies specified exclusions prohibited when damage is done by a peace officer.

posted_text:
👮 MN HF 4133 — Homeowner’s Insurance Policies: Peace Officer Damage Coverage

Starting January 1, 2027, Minnesota homeowner’s insurance policies must cover damage caused by peace officers, excluding coverage denials based on standard exclusions.

Jan. 1, 2027: Effective date.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/bill.php?b=House&f=HF4133&ssn=0&y=2025
